question: How does contiguous allocation compare to paging?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: How does contiguous allocation compare to paging?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: Contiguous allocation gives each process one unbroken block, while paging splits it into fixed-size frames.
beats.source_quote: contiguous allocation gives each process one unbroken block, while paging splits memory into fixed-size frames

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: So contiguous allocation suffers external fragmentation, while paging does not.
beats.source_quote: contiguous allocation suffers external fragmentation; paging does not
